text:
Type: green cube storage shelving unit
Use: storing books, records and boxes, dividing a room; living room, home office, children's room
Style: contemporary, modern, minimalist
Materials: painted board with a smooth even finish
Colors: bright grass green
Shape: upright rectangular case with a grid of eight square open cubes in two columns, thick flat panels, open back, chunky and boxy, stands upright or on its side
Feel: playful, bold, cheerful, graphic
Goes with: white walls, light wood, storage baskets, colorful textiles; modern, eclectic or kids' rooms

product.name: KALLAX
product.description: A simple unit can be enough storage for a limited space or the foundation for a larger storage solution if your needs change.
